description: Every field a call to auth may give; `directory` is Craft's, never the model's.

directory.description: the project folder, filled by Craft

imports.description: modules the mark and the look's names live in, when the app's own target does not declare them

into.description: the folder for the flow, relative to the project; Components/Auth when left out

launch.description: one line a `-destination` the flow opens for, `name = state`: signIn, signUp, forgot (Sign In with the reset sheet up), or code with an email (`auth.code = code "name@example.com"`)

look.description: one line a look role, `role = Swift` naming the app's own colour or font: `accent = Color.accent`, `title = Font.brandTitle`; a role left out reads the system's

mark.description: the app's mark at the head of Sign In and Sign Up: the Swift that makes a view the app has (`BrandMark()`), or an SF Symbol's name (`seal.fill`); person.crop.circle when left out

prefix.description: a prefix for the kit's types when the app already has names that clash: `Kit` writes KitAuthFlow

strings.description: one line a word on the screens, `key = "words"`: `signIn.title = "Welcome back"`; a key left out says its English default

tuning.description: one line a timing, size or symbol, `key = value`: `swap = spring 0.38 0.88`, `mark.turn = 42`, `forgot.detents = medium large`; a key left out keeps its default

title: What auth takes
